fullDesc: In 1504 Michelangelo's David was unveiled in Florence. Carved from a single block of marble that other sculptors had abandoned, the 5 metre statue is one of the great works of the Renaissance.
realFacts: He was only 26 when he began it
He painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling from 1508 to 1512
The statue now stands in the Accademia
A copy stands in the original square
